create_multihead_linear_attention: create a MultiheadLinearAttention module with specified embed_dim and num_heads for Linformer
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through MultiheadLinearAttention with query tensor and key_padding_mask
prune_attention_heads: prune specific attention heads from MultiheadLinearAttention to reduce model size
create_quantized_attention: create a QuantizedMultiheadLinearAttention module with padding-based compressed projection for quantized inference
get_compressed_projection: get compressed key and value projections using the compress_k layer weights
